name: Glass panes
summary: Flat glass from windows, doors, shelves, picture frames, oven doors and scanners.
uses: Glazing for shelter windows and cold frames
Covers for solar ovens, stills and water heaters
Not for wood-stove doors: replace stove glass only with ceramic stove glass (Drolet Escape 1800)
identify:
Windows, glass doors, shower screens, fridge shelves, oven doors, picture frames and scanner beds. Tempered glass has a small etched stamp in one corner, shatters into small cubes and cannot be cut.

Wood-stove door glass is a transparent ceramic (sold as ceramic glass), not ordinary glass: it takes firebox heat (NRCan wood heating, Drolet Escape 1800), so window and tempered glass cannot stand in for it.
test: Check the edges for chips: a chipped tempered pane can burst later. Plain glass can be scored and snapped; tempered glass cannot.

decay.note: Lasts. Stocks fall as storms and vandals break windows.

sources.title: NRCan wood heating: A Guide to Residential Wood Heating (Natural Resources Canada, 2002, cat. M92-23/2002E; archived copy)
Drolet Escape 1800: Wood Stove Owner's Manual Part 2, Installation and Operation Requirements (46240, 2022)
